cards.title: Should you move closer to family before school?
cards.body: Relocating near family before your child starts school involves real tradeoffs beyond finances. Building friendships takes time, and proximity to relatives has both benefits and hidden costs to consider carefully.

cards.title: Adult child moving back home? Managing the shift
cards.body: When graduates return home, the dynamic shifts from holiday visits to daily reality. Parents must navigate new boundaries while supporting their child through economic uncertainty.

cards.title: Balancing family and personal adventure as a parent
cards.body: The question of leaving your family for extreme pursuits raises ethical questions about parental responsibility. Can adventurers balance their ambitions with commitments to small children at home?

cards.title: What kids won't tell their parents
cards.body: Children share more than parents realize, but only with those they feel emotionally safe with. Research shows how building trust creates space for children to open up honestly.

cards.title: Phones banned from pupils' bags at UK schools
cards.body: England's government has strengthened guidance for schools to ban phones from pupils' bags and pockets. The stricter rules came into force in June to reduce classroom distractions and support focus.
